title: Tax
description: A tax withheld from pay (D38), the way payroll works it out: a paycheck's pay as a year's, less a yearly deduction, taxed in brackets, and a share of that for the paycheck. Traced in CALIBRATION.md.

deduction.description: Cents a year taken off pay before the brackets: the W-4's $8,600, an exemption.

brackets.description: From the lowest, each starting where the last ends. The first starts at 0.

over.description: Cents a year, after the deduction, where its rate starts.

rate.description: In hundredths of a percent: 620 is 6.2%.

cap.description: The most pay taxed in a calendar year, in cents: Social Security's wage base.
